page.content:
Arkie (Unknown - 10191 AG) was an Officer or House Trooper of House Atreides. He served in Thufir Hawat's unit and died during Hawat's group flight from Arrakeen during the Harkonnen and Sardaukar invasion of Arrakis.

page.overview:
Who is Arkie?

Arkie (Unknown - 10191 AG) was an Officer or House Trooper of House Atreides. He served in Thufir Hawat's unit and died during Hawat's group flight from Arrakeen during the Harkonnen and Sardaukar invasion of Arrakis.
